see.liveStatus: Eden Mill open; Eden Estuary indoor centre closed for repairs while outdoor viewing remains accessible.

rejected: Guardbridge Inn and the Eden Mill Lookout are bar/meal-led rather than café-led daytime entries.

providerChecks.officialRoutes: The council green-network review was checked; no maintained place-specific circular visitor route is published.

parking.reason: Eden Mill parking is for customers and the small reserve parking is tied to that visit; neither is represented as general public village parking.

toilets.reason: No council public toilet is listed; venue toilets are not represented as public facilities.

accessibility.note: Eden Mill states full lift access and disabled bays; the reserve-centre indoor closure is retained.

transport.note: The operator confirms frequent bus access from St Andrews and Leuchars connections.

exclusions: Customer-only university and distillery facilities are not presented as general public village services.
Guardbridge Inn and The Lookout are excluded from the café-led Eat category.
St Andrews and Leuchars services are not borrowed.
boundaryRule: Eden Mill, Tindal’s and the estuary viewpoint are physically inside the Guardbridge visitor boundary; nearby St Andrews assets are excluded.

sourceChecks.note: Official destination page confirms the visitor centre opened in September 2025.
Operator page confirms the working-distillery tour and £26 price.
Operator FAQ confirms hours, parking, public transport and accessibility.
University page confirms visitor welcome, weekday hours, coffee and lunches.
July 2026 trust update confirms the indoor closure and outdoor access.
